newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Photonix names Leason as chairman.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Photonix names Leason as chairman.

text.p: Advanced Photonix Inc said Monday it has appointed Hayden Leason as chairman of the board of directors to succeed James Ward.
Leason has been a director of the company since July 1995. Ward will remain on the board of directors.
Advanced Photonix also said in a statement that Robert Allison was elected as interim president and chief executive officer, effective immediately.

Allison is currently chief executive officer of Vis-A-Vis Communications Inc and the managing partner of Allison Venture. Prior to forming privately-held Allison Venture Partners, Allison was chief operating officer at Aurora Electronics Group Inc.
